descFull: The compounding context layer for AI coding agents, portable across IDEs.. Own the state. Rent the intelligence. Plain Markdown on your disk, driven by a session routine that turns today's work into what tomorrow's agent already knows. Swap models or switch IDEs on a whim. The intelligence is rented; the state belongs to you.
